Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\n On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nIn the case of the O(2)H· · · O(6) intra-molecular H-bonds for softwood fiber, the trend of content can be described as two phases. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the free OH(2) and OH(6) of softwood fiber, the relative content showed a slight increase trend in general. The enhancement of the free OH(2) and OH(6) was understandable, because there was the breakage of H-bonds among cellulosic molecules, which resulted in more extensive delamination and higher specific surface area (as shown in Figure S4 and Table S1 in Online Resource). This made cellulose more accessible to water and chemicals. However, for the free OH(2) and OH(6) of hardwood fiber, the number of the free OH(2) and OH(6) decreased by 21.65% from 14.32% to 11.22%, with revolutions increasing from 0 r to 4000 r, followed by an increase of 45.37% in the stage of refining from 4000 r to 12,000 r, along with an decrease of 17.11%. It could be explained by the instability of free OH groups, which makes it easy to form new H-bonds, such as O(2)H· · · O(6) or O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>)H-bonds. Thus although there is the formation of free OH(2) and OH(6) during fibrillation, the content of the free OH(2) and OH(6) might disease; meanwhile, the content of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) or the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds might increase upon drying.",

Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\n On the whole, the amount of the O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers decreased by 16.54% and 5.91% altogether, respectively. The decrease might be due to the cleavage among cellulose molecular chains under the mechanical action of PFI refining, which was closely related to internal and external fibrillation (as seen in Section 3.1). On the other hand, the increase illustrates that there was not only the breakage, but also the formation of O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) H-bonds. Both the fewer inter-molecular H-bonds and the lower CI (as Section 3.2 shows) will further improve the flexibility of cellulosic fibers, due to the higher mobility of molecular chains, the accessibility, and the WRV of fibers (as seen in Section 3.1).\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Efect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds\n[原文]\nAs to the O(3)H· · · O(5) intra-molecular H-bonds of softwood fiber, the content had a growth of 10.09% from 28.44% to 31.31% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r, and then had a slight decrease of 1.44% from 4000 r to 8000 r, followed by an increase of 13.16% until the end of refining. Overall, the trend was similar to that of hardwood fibers, which first increased and then had a decrease, followed by a growth. During the whole refining, the amount of $\\mathrm { O } ( 3 ) \\mathrm { H } \\cdots \\mathrm { O } ( 5 )$ H-bonds for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers showed an upward tendency and increased by 22.78% and 8.8%, respectively. The increase might be because the stable O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds might have not only less breakage under the action of water as destructor to the crystallites [30], but also creation in the amorphous region upon drying. Because hydrogen bond–covalent bond synergies play an important role in the cellulose stifness axial modulus, more O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds will enhance the cellulose stifness [33,34].\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. It had an increase of 3.5% from 31.4% to 32.5% in the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r and it then decreased by 21.57% from 4000 r to 12000 r, along with a growth of 15.26% in the last refining stage. For the content of the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds of hardwood fiber, it increased firstly and then had a decrease that was also followed by an increase. For both fibers, the content of O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds decreased, except for the stage of refining from 0 r to 4000 r. It might be due to the fact that the O(2)H· · · O(6) H-bonds, which are much more accessible to water, are less stable than O(3)H· · · O(5) H-bonds.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3.         "id": "C1",
        "text": "## 结论：检索到的文献证据与“阔叶木增幅更大”的前提相反\n\n本次检索到的语料中，只有 Li 2020（PFI 打浆，0–16,000 转）直接对比了针叶木与阔叶木浆的湿纸幅强度，其结论是：针叶木湿纸幅强度增幅更显著，阔叶木增幅较小 [1]。原文表述为“softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber” [1]。该结论为定性描述，文中未给出湿纸幅强度的数值、统计检验或误差范围。"
      },
      {
        "citation_refs": [
          "[6]"
        ],
        "id": "C2",
        "text": "**图3的目测读数（近似值，非原文引用的数值）** [6]\n图3左轴为“Tensile index of wet sheet (N·m/g)”，范围 0–8，两种浆共用同一左轴；黑点为湿纸幅抗张指数。据此目测：\n- 针叶木（a）：0 转约 0.8，16,000 转约 4.3–4.4，绝对增量约 3.5，约为初始值的 5 倍；\n- 阔叶木（b）：0 转约 0.7，16,000 转约 1.8–1.9，绝对增量约 1.1，约为初始值的 2.5 倍。"
      },
      {
        "citation_refs": [
          "[6]"
        ],
        "id": "C3",
        "text": "在本次条件下，针叶木的湿纸幅强度在绝对增量和相对倍数上均大于阔叶木；此外，阔叶木在整个打浆过程中始终处于更低的强度水平 [6]。图中数据点带有误差棒，但图中未标注样本数或统计显著性；并且两浆是在相同转数下比较，并未在相同打浆能量或相同打浆度（游离度）下比较，因此这种横向比较会受打浆条件差异干扰，不能直接等同于“阔叶木对打浆的固有响应更弱”。"
      },
      {
        "citation_refs": [
          "[1]"
        ],
        "id": "C4",
        "text": "**作者给出的解释**\n1. **纤维长度是关键**：原文明确写道“It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength”[1]。即湿纸幅靠纤维网络缠结承载，长纤维的搭接贡献更大。\n2. **两种浆的打浆形态响应不同**：PFI 过程中，针叶木的细小纤维含量呈上升趋势，并且纤维长度与宏细纤维化（macro-fibrillation）指数变化显著；而阔叶木的宏细纤维化指数和纤维长度这两项参数“相对针叶木无显著变化”（no significant variations relative to softwood fibers）[1]。\n   - 作者对此给出的**推测性**解释是：阔叶木施加的打浆压力更低（“It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers”）[1]。这是“might be”式推测，未做验证。\n   - 需注意：原文只报告了针叶木细小纤维含量上升，并未给出阔叶木细小纤维或比表面积的对比幅度。因此，“阔叶木细纤维化/细小纤维生成更少、可增加结合面积有限”属于由上述形态数据外推的解释，不是原文陈述 [1]。\n3. 零span抗张指数结果显示 PFI 未降低单纤维强度 [1]。由此推断差别更多来自网络结合与纤维长度而非单纤维被削弱，这是合理推断，但原文并未做此因果论证。"
      },

    "claim_assessments": [
      {
        "basis": {
          "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers.",
          "type": "reference_evidence"
        },
        "basis_locator": "E14",
        "claim_type": "fact",
        "id": "C1",
        "support": "partially_supported",
        "text": "## 结论：检索到的文献证据与“阔叶木增幅更大”的前提相反\n\n本次检索到的语料中，只有 Li 2020（PFI 打浆，0–16,000 转）直接对比了针叶木与阔叶木浆的湿纸幅强度，其结论是：针叶木湿纸幅强度增幅更显著，阔叶木增幅较小 [1]。原文表述为“softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber” [1]。该结论为定性描述，文中未给出湿纸幅强度的数值、统计检验或误差范围。"
      },
      {
        "basis": null,
        "basis_locator": "NONE",
        "claim_type": "fact",
        "id": "C2",
        "support": "supported",
        "text": "**图3的目测读数（近似值，非原文引用的数值）** [6]\n图3左轴为“Tensile index of wet sheet (N·m/g)”，范围 0–8，两种浆共用同一左轴；黑点为湿纸幅抗张指数。据此目测：\n- 针叶木（a）：0 转约 0.8，16,000 转约 4.3–4.4，绝对增量约 3.5，约为初始值的 5 倍；\n- 阔叶木（b）：0 转约 0.7，16,000 转约 1.8–1.9，绝对增量约 1.1，约为初始值的 2.5 倍。"
      },
      {
        "basis": {
          "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers.",
          "type": "reference_evidence"
        },
        "basis_locator": "E14",
        "claim_type": "fact",
        "id": "C3",
        "support": "partially_supported",
        "text": "在本次条件下，针叶木的湿纸幅强度在绝对增量和相对倍数上均大于阔叶木；此外，阔叶木在整个打浆过程中始终处于更低的强度水平 [6]。图中数据点带有误差棒，但图中未标注样本数或统计显著性；并且两浆是在相同转数下比较，并未在相同打浆能量或相同打浆度（游离度）下比较，因此这种横向比较会受打浆条件差异干扰，不能直接等同于“阔叶木对打浆的固有响应更弱”。"
      },
      {
        "basis": {
          "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers.",
          "type": "reference_evidence"
        },
        "basis_locator": "E14",
        "claim_type": "fact",
        "id": "C4",
        "support": "supported",
        "text": "**作者给出的解释**\n1. **纤维长度是关键**：原文明确写道“It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength”[1]。即湿纸幅靠纤维网络缠结承载，长纤维的搭接贡献更大。\n2. **两种浆的打浆形态响应不同**：PFI 过程中，针叶木的细小纤维含量呈上升趋势，并且纤维长度与宏细纤维化（macro-fibrillation）指数变化显著；而阔叶木的宏细纤维化指数和纤维长度这两项参数“相对针叶木无显著变化”（no significant variations relative to softwood fibers）[1]。\n   - 作者对此给出的**推测性**解释是：阔叶木施加的打浆压力更低（“It might be because of the lower refining pressure that was applied in hardwood fibers”）[1]。这是“might be”式推测，未做验证。\n   - 需注意：原文只报告了针叶木细小纤维含量上升，并未给出阔叶木细小纤维或比表面积的对比幅度。因此，“阔叶木细纤维化/细小纤维生成更少、可增加结合面积有限”属于由上述形态数据外推的解释，不是原文陈述 [1]。\n3. 零span抗张指数结果显示 PFI 未降低单纤维强度 [1]。由此推断差别更多来自网络结合与纤维长度而非单纤维被削弱，这是合理推断，但原文并未做此因果论证。"
      },
      {
        "basis": null,
        "basis_locator": "NONE",
        "claim_type": "fact",
        "id": "C5",

        "text": "**证据缺口**\n- 湿纸幅强度的具体数值、增幅百分比与统计显著性：原文未给出，只能依赖目测读图 [6]。\n- 是否在等打浆度/等能量下比较：原文按等转数比较；虽然打浆度和保水值随转数上升 [1]，但未给出两浆在等打浆度下的对照。\n- 若你所观察到的是其他体系（不同打浆设备或强度、高浓打浆、不同打浆度起点，或比较的是保水值、打浆度、结合面积等指标），本语料无相应数据支持，无法判断阔叶木是否确实“涨得更多”，需提供具体文献或条件再核对。"

{
  "key_point_scores": {
    "P1": 1,
    "P2": 1
  },
  "claim_assessments": [
    {
      "id": "C1",
      "text": "## 一、先核对问题中的前提\n\n在本次检索到文献中，结论与“阔叶木打浆后湿纸幅强度增幅更大”这一前提相反。Li 等（2020，PFI磨打浆，0–16 000 r）指出：**针叶木的湿纸幅强度增幅比阔叶木更显著**，并把这一点归因于“纤维长度对湿纸幅强度起重要作用”[1][5]。同一实验中，零距抗张（表征纤维自身强度）显示，打浆并没有降低纤维强度[6][10]。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C2",
      "text": "因此，就这套数据而言，不能直接解释“阔叶木涨得更多”；应先确认你所用的浆种、打浆方式和打浆强度下是否真的观察到这一现象。需要说明，该文正文只作趋势性描述，没有给出两种浆湿纸幅强度的绝对或相对增幅数值；Figure 3 的图像本身我未查看，无法判断图中是否含具体数值。",
      "claim_type": "scope",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "NONE",
      "basis": null
    },
    {
      "id": "C3",
      "text": "## 二、该文献给出的机理\n\n1. **湿纸幅强度主要受纤维长度影响。** 作者直接以纤维长度解释针叶木增幅更大，而不是以纤维间结合来解释[5]。\n2. **打浆提供的主要是“可结合面积”，同时提高纤维柔顺性。** PFI打浆使打浆度与保水值WRV显著上升；其原因是细纤维化产生了新的表面和更多孔隙[1]。润胀（以WRV表征）使纤维在横向更柔顺，从而改善纤维网络的纤维间结合强度[10]。该结合强度论证针对的是纤维间结合，不能直接等同于湿纸幅强度的增幅，后者在论文中另有单独测量；湿纸幅强度按 GB/T 12914-2008 测定[12]。\n3. **阔叶木的结构响应更弱，且打浆条件可能不对等。** 针叶木的宏观细纤维化指数与纤维长度变化显著，而阔叶木这两个参数“相对针叶木无显著变化”；作者**推测**原因可能是施加于阔叶木的打浆压力较低[1]。这是作者提出的可能解释，不是已经确立的因果关系。\n4. **氢键与结晶度的变化方向也不支持“阔叶木湿幅强度增幅更大”。** 从FT-IR去卷积得到的**相对含量**来看：分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键针叶木降 16.54%、阔叶木降 5.91%；分子内 O(3)H···O(5) 氢键分别升 22.78% 与 8.8%[2]。XRD 结晶度指数的**相对降幅**（相对降幅按论文报告口径）为：针叶木 CI-XI 降 4.66%、CI-XA 降 15.47%；阔叶木分别降 2.65%、19.4%[3]。这些只是结构和结晶参数，论文并未把它们与湿纸幅强度增幅作因果或排序关联，因此不能据此推断湿幅强度增幅顺序。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E14",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "In Figure 3, the tensile index, zero-span tensile index, and wet-web strength represented as a function of the refining revolutions. The increment of tensile strength is mainly caused by the increasing fibrillation and fines during PFI refining, as mentioned above. The wet–web strength of softwood fiber had a more significant increase when compared to that of hardwood fiber. It is for that fiber length plays an essential role in wet–web strength. The zero-span tensile index was usually used in characterizing the tensile strength of fibers. The results of the zero-span tensile index showed that PFI refining did not reduce fiber strength, which is consistent with the report of Kouko et al. [24]. The above results showed that PFI refining improved the extent of fibrillation (especially the internal fibrillation), the swelling of fibers, and the tensile strength of sheets without a decrease of the tensile strength of fibers."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C4",
      "text": "## 三、如果真的观察到阔叶木增幅更大：以下仅为假设，本批证据未验证\n\n- **基线/相对值效应**：阔叶木未打浆时湿幅强度可能更低，同样的绝对增量会表现为更大的相对增幅；该文未说明“更显著”指绝对值还是相对值。\n- **打浆条件不对等**：本研究对阔叶木施加的压力可能更低[1]；若改用等比能量或等强度打浆，短纤维浆会生成更多细小纤维，接触点增加，其结合面积增益可能更突出。\n- **测试干度差异**：论文湿幅强度按 GB/T 12914-2008 测定[12]，但未报告测试干度，无法排除其影响。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "NONE",
      "basis": null
    },
    {
      "id": "C5",
      "text": "## 四、未能解决的缺口\n\n- 该文献正文无湿纸幅强度数值表，Figure 3 未查看，故“针叶木增幅更显著”只能按作者的文字结论引用，无法给出具体数值或统计显著性。\n- 两种浆的原料、卡伯价/漂白状态、PFI 具体线压与比能量等条件在已获得片段中未出现。\n- “为什么在某些体系里阔叶木增幅更大”在本批证据中没有任何直接支撑；如需回答，必须补充等打浆强度、同干度湿幅强度对比的实验文献。",
      "claim_type": "scope",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "NONE",
      "basis": null
    }
  ],

PFI2-031 PFI打浆把纤维素从I型变成II型以后，结晶度为什么还会下降？

本轮重跑

## 先核对一个前提（证据与问题设定不完全一致）

现有文献中，PFI 打浆**并没有把纤维素从 I 型变成 II 型**：Li 等对软木和硬木浆 PFI 打浆（0–16000 转）的 XRD 结果显示，两种纤维的**晶型（polymorph）全程未变**，作者据此认为 PFI 属于"相对温和的机械处理"[3]；其 XRD 解析也只考虑纤维素 Iα/Iβ 的晶面（如 (1-10)、(110)、(200)）[5]。同一文献也指出，关于 PFI 打浆对结晶度的影响，前人结论互相矛盾，有的报道下降、有的报道先升后降，并无一致趋势[1]。

因此在讨论"为什么转变后结晶度还降"之前，建议先确认 XRD 上究竟是**峰位**（纤维素 II 的特征峰约在 2θ ≈ 12°、20°、21.8°）真的出现，还是仅峰形/峰强度变化被解读为晶型转变。

## 若确实发生了 I→II，结晶度仍下降的可能原因

1. **转变过程本身就伴随晶区破坏，两者并不互斥。** 该文献对 PFI 结晶度波动的解释是：初期 CI 下降说明机械作用"主要作用于结晶区"，后段下降则归因于"结晶区的持续破坏"[13]。水分子优先从亲水的 (1-10)/(110) 面渗入**准晶区（paracrystalline）**，使这些晶面更易受机械作用，造成链断裂与干燥时的共结晶（cocrystallization）并存[6][18]。也就是说：残余晶体可能已重排为 II 型，但同时有相当部分链区被转化为无定形，总量/有序尺寸变小，表观结晶度自然下降。文献中软木 CI‑XI 从 73.23% 降至 69.82%、CI‑XA 从 40.46% 降至 34.20%（16000 转），硬木分别从 75.55%→73.55%、47.16%→38.01%[12]；线性降幅报道为软木 −4.66%/−15.47%、硬木 −2.65%/−19.4%[8]。

2. **晶粒尺寸极小，晶型重排带来应变与缺陷。** 这些浆的晶粒垂直方向尺寸仅约 3–5 nm[12]，且不同晶面响应不一致——垂直 (110) 面的尺寸波动最大（水化 + 机械作用），而垂直 (200) 面的尺寸反而上升（相邻微纤丝 (200) 面在干燥时对齐、链合并）[6][18]。如此小的晶粒在堆垛方式改变时，峰宽化/应变增加会使面积法结晶度和 Scherrer 晶粒尺寸同时"下降"，这反映的是有序度/缺陷，而不只是晶型种类。

3. **测量层面的可比性问题（重要）。** 本文的 CI‑XI 用纤维素 Iβ 的 (200) 峰（2θ 22–23°）与 18–19° 的无定形谷计算[5]，这是为纤维素 I 标定的 Segal 类指标；两种指标本身差异巨大（如未打浆软木 CI‑XI 73.23% vs CI‑XA 40.46%，作者归因于无定形贡献过拟合）[2][9][12]。晶型换成 II 后主峰位置改变，同一公式给出的数值不宜与 I 型样品直接相减比较——所以"结晶度下降"中可能有一部分是指标伪影，而非真实结晶度变化。相关结论需用分峰法（Pearson VII 等）[5]或 Rietveld 全谱拟合重新验证。

4. **可能的相关机制（本库无证据，属缺口）**：纤维素 II 反平行链堆垛、经溶胀/去晶化路径生成，其本征结晶度与晶粒尺寸通常低于纤维素 I。这一点**未能在本次检索到的文献中找到支撑**（文献库仅有 1 篇 PFI 相关文献，且其样品晶型未变），因此不作定量断言。

## 建议的最小验证集
- XRD 报告**原始峰位与分峰参数**（不只报一个 CI 数），确认是否有 12°/20° 的 II 型峰；
- 同时给出 CI‑XI、CI‑XA 及 Scherrer 尺寸，并注明所用公式的晶型适用性[5]；
- 用 FT-IR（如 1430/897 cm⁻¹ 比值）或 CP/MAS ¹³C NMR 交叉验证晶型与有序度——本文亦用 FT‑IR 氢键解卷积并与 CI 做相关（Pearson r ≈ 0.89–0.91，p<0.05）[3][4]，说明结晶度变化与分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量同向变化，可作为独立判据。

**证据缺口**：关于"纤维素 II 本征结晶度低于纤维素 I"以及"PFI 打浆可诱导 I→II"这两点，本次两轮检索均未获得文献证据；上述第 1–3 条机制有[5][6][12][13][18]支持，第 4 条仅为待验证假设。

[2][7]。因此，文中讨论的结晶度下降，针对的是**仍为纤维素 I 型（按 Iβ 晶格标定）**的样品；\"纤维素 II 型结晶度还下降\"并不是该文的结论。\n\n## 文中实际观测到的结晶度变化\n\n打浆转数范围为 0、4000、8000、12000、16000 转。针叶木与阔叶木的 CI-XI（峰强法）和 CI-XA（峰面积/拟合面积法）都表现为**波动而非单调下降**：先降低，再回升，随后下降 [2][5]。\n\n端点数值（表 1）[5]：\n\n| 样品 | CI-XI | CI-XA |\n|---|---|---|\n| 针叶木 | 73.23% → 69.82% | 40.46% → 34.20% |\n| 阔叶木 | 75.55% → 73.55% | 47.16% → 38.01% |\n\n原文表述的降幅（4.66%、15.47%；2.65%、19.4%）是**相对降幅**；按表 1 数值换算，绝对降幅约为 3.4、6.3、2.0、9.2 个百分点（后者为本次换算，并非原文给出的数字）。表中中间转数点也有回升（如针叶木 CI-XI 在 8000 转回升至 72.54%），所以用端点差值描述趋势会掩盖这种波动 [5]。\n\n## 作者给出的机理解释（原文用\"可能/可解释为\"等推断性措辞）\n\n- **初期 CI 下降**：机械作用**可能**主要作用于结晶区，使晶区受到破坏；\n- **随后 CI 回升**：作用力**可能**更多转向无定形区，干燥过程中在打浆的机械与热作用下**可能发生共结晶**；\n- **再下降**：结晶区**可能**被持续破坏 [2]。\n\n这些是作者提出的阶段性假设，并未通过分区定量或原位手段直接验证，因此不应表述为已确定的机制。\n\n## 一个重要的反直觉细节：CI 下降，但 (200) 方向微晶尺寸反而增大\n\n打浆过程中，两种浆**垂直于 (200) 晶面**的微晶尺寸呈上升趋势（表 1：针叶木 4.5→4.7 nm，阔叶木 4.5→4.7 nm）。作者将其归因于分子链并合（coalescence）或相邻微纤丝在干燥时 (200) 面取向一致的结晶学堆叠，**也可能**是因为 (200) 面较难被水分子渗透、受到的劈裂作用更弱 [5]。垂直 (110)/(1-10) 方向的尺寸波动更大，作者认为这与这些亲水晶面在准晶区间可被水分子渗入、从而承受更多机械作用（并伴随黏附/共结晶与断链）有关 [2][7]。因此，\"结晶度指数下降\"不能简单等同于\"晶体整体变小或全部非晶化\"。\n\n## 氢键相关性的证据（相关，不等于因果）\n\nO(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量也呈\"先降—升—再降\"的变化，与 CI-XI 的 Pearson 相关系数为针叶木 **0.912**、阔叶木 **0.889**（均 p<0.05）。作者**推测**这是由于结晶区中该氢键的含量高于无定形区 [6]。该证据属于统计相关性；另外，统计时 CI-XI 与 CI-XA 本身也显著相关（0.919 / 0.925，p<0.05），所以不能据此推断\"氢键变化导致结晶度变化\"的因果链 [7]。\n\n## 测量方法上的限定（以及一条未被文献支持的推断）\n\n- CI-XI 用 Segal 式：以 2θ 22–23° 的 (200) 峰强与 18–19° 无定形最低强度计算；CI-XA 由 Savitzky–Golay 平滑、线性基线校正后用 Pearson VII 分峰，取晶峰面积占比 [8]。文中明确声明所有指标均按 **Iβ** 晶格标定（天然纤维素含 Iα/Iβ 两种多晶型）[8]。\n- CI-XI 显著高于 CI-XA，作者认为**可能是** CI-XA 分析中无定形贡献被过度拟合所致 [7]。\n- 微晶尺寸由 Scherrer 方程算出；因未扣除仪器展宽，计算值**可能低于**真实值 [8]。\n- **以下是我的推断，并非本文内容，也未经本次证据验证**：纤维素 II 的主峰位置与 I 型不同，把基于 Iβ (200) 的指数直接用于 II 型样品，可能得到失真的\"表观结晶度\"。若你的资料来源确实发生了 I→II 转变，需要核对该来源的晶型判定与结晶度算法是否匹配，而不能沿用本文的数值。\n\n##         "[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nMechanical, chemical, and biological treatments are usually adopted to obtain the desired physical and mechanical properties and for further utilization of the natural cellulosic fibers. Therein, Papirindustriens forskningsinstitut (PFI) refining is the most common laboratory refiner in order to improve the inter-fiber bonding capacity [1] and accessibility [2,3], and manufacture the micro-fibrillated or nano-fibrillated cellulose [4–6]. The main efects of PFI refining on fibers are: (i) internal fibrillation—delaminating, loosening, and swelling of fiber wall; (ii) external fibrillation—peeling of fibrils from the fiber surface while remaining attached; (iii) fiber shortening—fiber cutting due to shearing action, and (iv) fines formation—primary fines come from ray cells and parenchyma cells and microfibrils that are caused by fiber shortening or external fibrillation. Moreover, the PFI refining could be adopted to obtain a higher internal fibrillation than other laboratory refiners [1]. These efects of the PFI refining on cellulosic fibers will improve the accessibility, the swelling, the flexibility, and the inter-fiber bonding capacity of fibers.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\n It is assumed that these changes in the macro-level structure and properties are related to the changes of crystallinity and H-bonding network during refining [7,8].\n\nThere are some diferent conclusions regarding to the efects of PFI refining on crystallinity of cellulose, not like that of ball milling, which efectively reduces the crystallinity as the treatment progresses. Although some researchers considered that the crystallinity decreased during PFI refining for corn stover [9] or softwood pulp [10], some researchers reported that the crystallinity increased first and then decreased with the degree of refining for hardwood bleached kraft pulp fibers [11] or for unbleached eucalyptus fibers [12]. Moreover, Zhao et al. [7] reported that the crystallinity initially fluctuated upward and then downward, followed by a repeating fluctuation with PFI refining for tobacco stem mechanical pulp. None of the previous studies identified a clear trend, but the results were that the crystallinity varied during PFI refinement. Based on the large proportion of H-bonds in crystalline region of cellulose, it can be assumed that the H-bonding network might change during PFI refining.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nFourier transformation infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), which is sensitive to molecular structure, can be as an indirect measurement for studying H-bonding network. FT-IR deconvolution of hydroxyl groups band was adopted in order to study the changes of the energy of H-bonds and the H-bonding distance during delignification [13] or the deconstruction of cellulose [14]. Moreover, it was used to study the diferences of the content of H-bonds not only between dislocation region and normal region [15], but also among plant species [16,17]. Regarding the changes of H-bonding network during PFI refining, Yuan et al. [18] reported that the content of H-bonds and crystallinity index (CI) of eucalyptus fibers changed with the increment of beating time. Subsequently, Zhao et al. [8] found that the H-bonding energy for O(6)H· · · O(3<sup>0</sup>) inter-molecular H-bonds decreased by 12.9% and evolutions of the content of certain H-bonds difered at various refining stages.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 1. Introduction\n[原文]\nThere is still a lack of literature on the efects of PFI refinement on the H-bonding network. Particularly, the relationship between the content of H-bonds and crystallinity is still worthy of further study, which will deepen the understanding of the molecular aggregation and distribution of H-bonds, providing a molecular-scale explanation for the variations in accessibility, swelling, flexibility, and fibrillation of cellulosic fibers during PFI refinement. Therefore, this work explored the efects of PFI refinement on the CI, crystallite size, energy of H-bonds, H-bonding distance, and content of H-bonds for softwood pulp fibers and hardwood pulp fibers. Attempts were made in order to establish the correlations between the CI and content of various H-bonds.",

Results and Discussions > 3.2. Efect of PFI Refining on Crystalline Index and Crystallite Size\n[原文]\nThe trends of CI (CI-XI and CI-XA) for softwood fibers and hardwood fibers were all similar, decreasing first and then increasing, along with a decline, as shown in Figure 4. The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the diferent regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region.\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 3. Results and Discussions > 3.2. The samples were scanned at 40 kV and 30 mA in a 2θ range of $4 { - } 4 0 ^ { \\circ }$ at 1<sup>◦</sup>/min. It is well known that two polymorphs, cellulose Iα and Iβ, are present in native cellulose; for clarity, all of the reflections indexed here are on the Iβ lattice. Before analysis, the experimental data is nine point smoothed with Savitzky–Golay algorithm. The two types of CI values were obtained from peak intensity method (CI − XI) and peak fitting (CI-XA), respectively. The CI − XI was calculated as in Equation (2) [19].\n\n[原文片段不连续]\n\n[章节标签（程序整理，非原文）] 2. Methods > 2.4. Subsequently, the baseline-corrected difractograms were deconvoluted with the Pearson VII function. The value of the CI-XA equals the area percentage occupied by crystalline peaks over the total area of the difraction pattern [20].         "text": "## 结论（对前提的修正）\n\n**在本次提供的文献中，并不存在“PFI 打浆使纤维素 I 型转变为 II 型”这一前提。** XRD 结果表明，针叶木浆与阔叶木浆在**整个 PFI 打浆过程中晶型均未发生变化**（原始谱图见 Online Resource 图 S1、S2）；作者据此把 PFI 打浆判断为\"相对温和的机械处理\" [2][7]。因此，文中讨论的结晶度下降，针对的是**仍为纤维素 I 型（按 Iβ 晶格标定）**的样品；\"纤维素 II 型结晶度还下降\"并不是该文的结论。"

        "text": "## 作者给出的机理解释（原文用\"可能/可解释为\"等推断性措辞）\n\n- **初期 CI 下降**：机械作用**可能**主要作用于结晶区，使晶区受到破坏；\n- **随后 CI 回升**：作用力**可能**更多转向无定形区，干燥过程中在打浆的机械与热作用下**可能发生共结晶**；\n- **再下降**：结晶区**可能**被持续破坏 [2]。"

        "id": "C7",
        "text": "## 一个重要的反直觉细节：CI 下降，但 (200) 方向微晶尺寸反而增大\n\n打浆过程中，两种浆**垂直于 (200) 晶面**的微晶尺寸呈上升趋势（表 1：针叶木 4.5→4.7 nm，阔叶木 4.5→4.7 nm）。作者将其归因于分子链并合（coalescence）或相邻微纤丝在干燥时 (200) 面取向一致的结晶学堆叠，**也可能**是因为 (200) 面较难被水分子渗透、受到的劈裂作用更弱 [5]。垂直 (110)/(1-10) 方向的尺寸波动更大，作者认为这与这些亲水晶面在准晶区间可被水分子渗入、从而承受更多机械作用（并伴随黏附/共结晶与断链）有关 [2][7]。因此，\"结晶度指数下降\"不能简单等同于\"晶体整体变小或全部非晶化\"。"
      },
      {
        "citation_refs": [
          "[6]",
          "[7]"
        ],
        "id": "C8",
        "text": "## 氢键相关性的证据（相关，不等于因果）\n\nO(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量也呈\"先降—升—再降\"的变化，与 CI-XI 的 Pearson 相关系数为针叶木 **0.912**、阔叶木 **0.889**（均 p<0.05）。作者**推测**这是由于结晶区中该氢键的含量高于无定形区 [6]。该证据属于统计相关性；另外，统计时 CI-XI 与 CI-XA 本身也显著相关（0.919 / 0.925，p<0.05），所以不能据此推断\"氢键变化导致结晶度变化\"的因果链 [7]。"
      },
      {
        "citation_refs": [
          "[8]",
          "[7]"
        ],
        "id": "C9",
        "text": "## 测量方法上的限定（以及一条未被文献支持的推断）\n\n- CI-XI 用 Segal 式：以 2θ 22–23° 的 (200) 峰强与 18–19° 无定形最低强度计算；CI-XA 由 Savitzky–Golay 平滑、线性基线校正后用 Pearson VII 分峰，取晶峰面积占比 [8]。文中明确声明所有指标均按 **Iβ** 晶格标定（天然纤维素含 Iα/Iβ 两种多晶型）[8]。\n- CI-XI 显著高于 CI-XA，作者认为**可能是** CI-XA 分析中无定形贡献被过度拟合所致 [7]。\n- 微晶尺寸由 Scherrer 方程算出；因未扣除仪器展宽，计算值**可能低于**真实值 [8]。\n- **以下是我的推断，并非本文内容，也未经本次证据验证**：纤维素 II 的主峰位置与 I 型不同，把基于 Iβ (200) 的指数直接用于 II 型样品，可能得到失真的\"表观结晶度\"。若你的资料来源确实发生了 I→II 转变，需要核对该来源的晶型判定与结晶度算法是否匹配，而不能沿用本文的数值。"
      },

        "text": "## 未能解决的证据缺口\n\n1. 本次检索到的语料中只有这一篇 PFI 相关文献，**没有任何报告\"PFI 打浆导致纤维素 I→II\"的原始数据**（通常 I→II 转变需碱化/丝光或溶解再生等处理）。若你指的是另一篇论文，请提供出处。\n2. 已获取的证据未包含该文的浆料细节（是否漂白硫酸盐浆、打浆浓度、比压、间隙等）与误差/重复性信息，因此不能对条件与不确定度作进一步说明。\n3. 未对图 4、图 5、图 8、图 9 及表 1 的图片做像素级查看，以上数值与趋势均依据正文与表 1 的文本记录 [2][5][6]，不含图像读数结论。"

        "text": "## 测量方法上的限定（以及一条未被文献支持的推断）\n\n- CI-XI 用 Segal 式：以 2θ 22–23° 的 (200) 峰强与 18–19° 无定形最低强度计算；CI-XA 由 Savitzky–Golay 平滑、线性基线校正后用 Pearson VII 分峰，取晶峰面积占比 [8]。文中明确声明所有指标均按 **Iβ** 晶格标定（天然纤维素含 Iα/Iβ 两种多晶型）[8]。\n- CI-XI 显著高于 CI-XA，作者认为**可能是** CI-XA 分析中无定形贡献被过度拟合所致 [7]。\n- 微晶尺寸由 Scherrer 方程算出；因未扣除仪器展宽，计算值**可能低于**真实值 [8]。\n- **以下是我的推断，并非本文内容，也未经本次证据验证**：纤维素 II 的主峰位置与 I 型不同，把基于 Iβ (200) 的指数直接用于 II 型样品，可能得到失真的\"表观结晶度\"。若你的资料来源确实发生了 I→II 转变，需要核对该来源的晶型判定与结晶度算法是否匹配，而不能沿用本文的数值。"
      },

        "text": "## 未能解决的证据缺口\n\n1. 本次检索到的语料中只有这一篇 PFI 相关文献，**没有任何报告\"PFI 打浆导致纤维素 I→II\"的原始数据**（通常 I→II 转变需碱化/丝光或溶解再生等处理）。若你指的是另一篇论文，请提供出处。\n2. 已获取的证据未包含该文的浆料细节（是否漂白硫酸盐浆、打浆浓度、比压、间隙等）与误差/重复性信息，因此不能对条件与不确定度作进一步说明。\n3. 未对图 4、图 5、图 8、图 9 及表 1 的图片做像素级查看，以上数值与趋势均依据正文与表 1 的文本记录 [2][5][6]，不含图像读数结论。"

      {
        "basis": {
          "text": "The cellulose polymorph of these two fibers had no change during PFI treatment, which illustrates that the PFI refining is a relatively mild mechanical treatment, as the results of XRD in Online Resource (Figures S1 and S2) show.",
          "type": "reference_evidence"
        },
        "basis_locator": "E24",
        "claim_type": "fact",
        "id": "C1",
        "support": "supported",
        "text": "## 结论（对前提的修正）\n\n**在本次提供的文献中，并不存在“PFI 打浆使纤维素 I 型转变为 II 型”这一前提。** XRD 结果表明，针叶木浆与阔叶木浆在**整个 PFI 打浆过程中晶型均未发生变化**（原始谱图见 Online Resource 图 S1、S2）；作者据此把 PFI 打浆判断为\"相对温和的机械处理\" [2][7]。因此，文中讨论的结晶度下降，针对的是**仍为纤维素 I 型（按 Iβ 晶格标定）**的样品；\"纤维素 II 型结晶度还下降\"并不是该文的结论。"
      },

Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region. Recently, researches indicated that plant cell walls commonly contained microfibrils with 18 cellulose chains [ 26 ]. Frequently adopted arrangements of the 18 cellulose chains are 234432, 34443, and 333333 [ 27 ]. Therein, 234432 arrangement was found to be more probable based on calculation [ 28 ].         "text": "## 一个重要的反直觉细节：CI 下降，但 (200) 方向微晶尺寸反而增大\n\n打浆过程中，两种浆**垂直于 (200) 晶面**的微晶尺寸呈上升趋势（表 1：针叶木 4.5→4.7 nm，阔叶木 4.5→4.7 nm）。作者将其归因于分子链并合（coalescence）或相邻微纤丝在干燥时 (200) 面取向一致的结晶学堆叠，**也可能**是因为 (200) 面较难被水分子渗透、受到的劈裂作用更弱 [5]。垂直 (110)/(1-10) 方向的尺寸波动更大，作者认为这与这些亲水晶面在准晶区间可被水分子渗入、从而承受更多机械作用（并伴随黏附/共结晶与断链）有关 [2][7]。因此，\"结晶度指数下降\"不能简单等同于\"晶体整体变小或全部非晶化\"。"
      },

        "text": "## 未能解决的证据缺口\n\n1. 本次检索到的语料中只有这一篇 PFI 相关文献，**没有任何报告\"PFI 打浆导致纤维素 I→II\"的原始数据**（通常 I→II 转变需碱化/丝光或溶解再生等处理）。若你指的是另一篇论文，请提供出处。\n2. 已获取的证据未包含该文的浆料细节（是否漂白硫酸盐浆、打浆浓度、比压、间隙等）与误差/重复性信息，因此不能对条件与不确定度作进一步说明。\n3. 未对图 4、图 5、图 8、图 9 及表 1 的图片做像素级查看，以上数值与趋势均依据正文与表 1 的文本记录 [2][5][6]，不含图像读数结论。"
      }
    ],

  "claim_assessments": [
    {
      "id": "C1",
      "text": "## 先核对一个前提（证据与问题设定不完全一致）\n\n现有文献中，PFI 打浆**并没有把纤维素从 I 型变成 II 型**：Li 等对软木和硬木浆 PFI 打浆（0–16000 转）的 XRD 结果显示，两种纤维的**晶型（polymorph）全程未变**，作者据此认为 PFI 属于\"相对温和的机械处理\"[3]；其 XRD 解析也只考虑纤维素 Iα/Iβ 的晶面（如 (1-10)、(110)、(200)）[5]。同一文献也指出，关于 PFI 打浆对结晶度的影响，前人结论互相矛盾，有的报道下降、有的报道先升后降，并无一致趋势[1]。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "supported",
      "basis_locator": "E24",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The cellulose polymorph of these two fibers had no change during PFI treatment, which illustrates that the PFI refining is a relatively mild mechanical treatment, as the results of XRD in Online Resource (Figures S1 and S2) show."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C2",
      "text": "因此在讨论\"为什么转变后结晶度还降\"之前，建议先确认 XRD 上究竟是**峰位**（纤维素 II 的特征峰约在 2θ ≈ 12°、20°、21.8°）真的出现，还是仅峰形/峰强度变化被解读为晶型转变。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "unsupported",
      "basis_locator": "NONE",
      "basis": null
    },
    {
      "id": "C3",
      "text": "## 若确实发生了 I→II，结晶度仍下降的可能原因\n\n1. **转变过程本身就伴随晶区破坏，两者并不互斥。** 该文献对 PFI 结晶度波动的解释是：初期 CI 下降说明机械作用\"主要作用于结晶区\"，后段下降则归因于\"结晶区的持续破坏\"[13]。水分子优先从亲水的 (1-10)/(110) 面渗入**准晶区（paracrystalline）**，使这些晶面更易受机械作用，造成链断裂与干燥时的共结晶（cocrystallization）并存[6][18]。也就是说：残余晶体可能已重排为 II 型，但同时有相当部分链区被转化为无定形，总量/有序尺寸变小，表观结晶度自然下降。文献中软木 CI‑XI 从 73.23% 降至 69.82%、CI‑XA 从 40.46% 降至 34.20%（16000 转），硬木分别从 75.55%→73.55%、47.16%→38.01%[12]；线性降幅报道为软木 −4.66%/−15.47%、硬木 −2.65%/−19.4%[8]。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "E11",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The fluctuation of the CI was probably because of the mechanical action of PFI refining on the different regions of cellulose. In the first refining stage, the decrease of the CI showed that mechanical treatment may mainly act in the crystalline region. Subsequently, the growth of the CI could be interpreted as greater force acting on the amorphous region in which cocrystallization might occur upon drying under the mechanical and thermal action of PFI refining. The subsequent decrease might be the continuous destruction of crystalline region."
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C4",
      "text": "2. **晶粒尺寸极小，晶型重排带来应变与缺陷。** 这些浆的晶粒垂直方向尺寸仅约 3–5 nm[12]，且不同晶面响应不一致——垂直 (110) 面的尺寸波动最大（水化 + 机械作用），而垂直 (200) 面的尺寸反而上升（相邻微纤丝 (200) 面在干燥时对齐、链合并）[6][18]。如此小的晶粒在堆垛方式改变时，峰宽化/应变增加会使面积法结晶度和 Scherrer 晶粒尺寸同时\"下降\"，这反映的是有序度/缺陷，而不只是晶型种类。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "B047",
      "basis": {
        "type": "paper_text",
        "text": "ydrophilic (110) planes in paracrystalline region (hydration), and then it made these planes suffer more mechanical actions, so there was more adhesion (cocrystallization) and cleavage of cellulose chains created for (110) plane during PFI refining. However, the crystallite size that was perpendicular to (200) lattice plane of two fibers had an upward trend during PFI refining. It could be explained in terms of coalescence of chains or some crystallographic stacking of adjacent microfibrils, where the (200) planes were aligned upon drying [ 30 ]. Additionally, it was probably due to the weaker cleavage effect on (200) lattice planes that was hard for water molecules to penetrate. 3.3. Effect of PFI Refining on H-Bonding Energies, H-Bonding Distances, and Content of H-Bonds A mixture of inter-molecular and intra-molecular H-bonds is considered to be the cause for the broadening of OH bands in the FT-IR spectra. Therefore, taking derivative of the OH bands can improve the resolution of v",
        "document_id": "doc_0fcf2a50cfa02d21",
        "start": 18000,
        "end": 19000
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C5",
      "text": "3. **测量层面的可比性问题（重要）。** 本文的 CI‑XI 用纤维素 Iβ 的 (200) 峰（2θ 22–23°）与 18–19° 的无定形谷计算[5]，这是为纤维素 I 标定的 Segal 类指标；两种指标本身差异巨大（如未打浆软木 CI‑XI 73.23% vs CI‑XA 40.46%，作者归因于无定形贡献过拟合）[2][9][12]。晶型换成 II 后主峰位置改变，同一公式给出的数值不宜与 I 型样品直接相减比较——所以\"结晶度下降\"中可能有一部分是指标伪影，而非真实结晶度变化。相关结论需用分峰法（Pearson VII 等）[5]或 Rietveld 全谱拟合重新验证。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "E10",
      "basis": {
        "type": "reference_evidence",
        "text": "The value of the CI-XI was remarkably higher than the CI-XA, which might be caused by the over-fitting of amorphous contribution in the analysis of CI-XA. However, the CI-XI and the CI-XA were correlated significantly for both softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, with a correlation coefficient of 0.919 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.925 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers, respectively,"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "C6",
      "text": "4. **可能的相关机制（本库无证据，属缺口）**：纤维素 II 反平行链堆垛、经溶胀/去晶化路径生成，其本征结晶度与晶粒尺寸通常低于纤维素 I。这一点**未能在本次检索到的文献中找到支撑**（文献库仅有 1 篇 PFI 相关文献，且其样品晶型未变），因此不作定量断言。",
      "claim_type": "scope",
      "support": "unsupported",
      "basis_locator": "NONE",
      "basis": null
    },
    {
      "id": "C7",
      "text": "## 建议的最小验证集\n- XRD 报告**原始峰位与分峰参数**（不只报一个 CI 数），确认是否有 12°/20° 的 II 型峰；\n- 同时给出 CI‑XI、CI‑XA 及 Scherrer 尺寸，并注明所用公式的晶型适用性[5]；\n- 用 FT-IR（如 1430/897 cm⁻¹ 比值）或 CP/MAS ¹³C NMR 交叉验证晶型与有序度——本文亦用 FT‑IR 氢键解卷积并与 CI 做相关（Pearson r ≈ 0.89–0.91，p<0.05）[3][4]，说明结晶度变化与分子间 O(6)H···O(3′) 氢键含量同向变化，可作为独立判据。",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "NONE",
      "basis": null
    },
    {
      "id": "C8",
      "text": "**证据缺口**：关于\"纤维素 II 本征结晶度低于纤维素 I\"以及\"PFI 打浆可诱导 I→II\"这两点，本次两轮检索均未获得文献证据；上述第 1–3 条机制有[5][6][12][13][18]支持，第 4 条仅为待验证假设。",
      "claim_type": "scope",
      "support": "partially_supported",
      "basis_locator": "NONE",
      "basis": null
    }

      "text": "## 先核对一个前提（证据与问题设定不完全一致）\n\n现有文献中，PFI 打浆**并没有把纤维素从 I 型变成 II 型**：Li 等对软木和硬木浆 PFI 打浆（0–16000 转）的 XRD 结果显示，两种纤维的**晶型（polymorph）全程未变**，作者据此认为 PFI 属于\"相对温和的机械处理\"[3]；其 XRD 解析也只考虑纤维素 Iα/Iβ 的晶面（如 (1-10)、(110)、(200)）[5]。同一文献也指出，关于 PFI 打浆对结晶度的影响，前人结论互相矛盾，有的报道下降、有的报道先升后降，并无一致趋势[1]。",

PFI2-032 论文里氢键含量和CI-XI的相关系数是针叶木0.919、阔叶木0.925吧？这么高是不是就能用CI-XI直接算出氢键含量了？

沿用上轮

## 更正后的结论

**① 0.919 / 0.925 对应的对象是错的：它们是 CI-XI 与 CI-XA 之间的相关系数，并非氢键含量与 CI-XI 之间的相关系数。**
原文：“the CI-XI and the CI-XA were correlated significantly for both softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, with a correlation coefficient of 0.919 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.925 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers”[1]。CI-XI 是用 XRD 峰**强度比**得到的结晶指数，CI-XA 是用 XRD 峰**面积比**得到的结晶指数，两者都是结晶度的度量[1][5]。文中把 CI-XI 明显高于 CI-XA 解释为可能由分析 CI-XA 时对非晶部分贡献过拟合所致，这是一种推测（“might be caused”）[1]。

**② 氢键含量与 CI-XI 的真实相关系数是：软木 0.912、阔叶木 0.889（均 p<0.05），针对的是 O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键的相对含量**[2]。需注意原文内部不一致：摘要给出的是软木 **0.888**、阔叶木 0.889[3]。仅凭现有材料无法判断哪个数值正确，引用时应注明正文 0.912 与摘要 0.888 存在矛盾，或回原文核实。

**③ 因此不能用 CI-XI “直接算出”氢键含量。**
- 作者自己的表述只是趋势推测：“there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H···O(3)′ H-bonds… Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H···O(3)′ H-bonds **might be generally speculated** based on CI-XI while refining”[4]，并没有宣称可以定量换算。
- 在所检索到的章节中，未见任何回归方程或换算公式；这是“检索范围内未见”，不能断言全文一定没有，需要回原文全文核实。
- 这些相关性是在 **PFI 打浆处理中**（0、4000、8000、12000、16000 r 共 5 个水平，每个树种 5 个点）内部得到的[5][6]；据表 1、表 2 推断，每树种只有 5 个配对点，样本量很小，r≈0.9 足以说明趋势一致，但不足以支撑外推到其他原料或打浆条件（此为统计判断，不是原文结论）。
- 该“氢键含量”是 FT-IR 羟基谱带（3000–3700 cm⁻¹）去卷积后按峰面积占比得到的**相对含量**[6]，因此不是绝对含量；相关也不等于因果。
- 并且并不是所有氢键都能由 CI-XI 代表：O(2)H···O(6) 与自由 OH(2)/OH(6) 在晶区与非晶区差别较小，与 CI-XI 的相关性“poor”；O(3)H···O(5) 被认为稳定、变化很小，本文未讨论其与 CI-XI 的相关性[2]。作者把 O(6)H···O(3′) 与 CI-XI 趋势相似归因于结晶区该类氢键含量高于非晶区[2]，这属于机理推测（“might be because”）。

**④ 建议表述**：“CI-XI 与 CI-XA 高度相关（软木 0.919、阔叶木 0.925，p<0.05）[1]；CI-XI 与 O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键相对含量显著正相关（正文：软木 0.912、阔叶木 0.889；摘要：0.888/0.889）[2][3]。作者据此仅提出可用 CI-XI 大致推测该氢键含量的变化趋势[4]，并未建立定量换算关系，不宜作为由 CI-XI 计算氢键含量的依据。”

**未解决的信息缺口**：正文与摘要中软木相关系数不一致（0.912 vs 0.888）的原因；以及全文是否给出过回归方程，现有证据不足以判断。

      "basis": {
        "text": "The value of the CI-XI was remarkably higher than the CI-XA, which might be caused by the over-fitting of amorphous contribution in the analysis of CI-XA.       "id": "C1",
      "support": "supported",
      "text": "## 更正后的结论\n\n**① 0.919 / 0.925 对应的对象是错的：它们是 CI-XI 与 CI-XA 之间的相关系数，并非氢键含量与 CI-XI 之间的相关系数。**\n原文：“the CI-XI and the CI-XA were correlated significantly for both softwood fibers and hardwood fibers, with a correlation coefficient of 0.919 (p < 0.05) for softwood fibers and 0.925 (p < 0.05) for hardwood fibers”[1]。CI-XI 是用 XRD 峰**强度比**得到的结晶指数，CI-XA 是用 XRD 峰**面积比**得到的结晶指数，两者都是结晶度的度量[1][5]。文中把 CI-XI 明显高于 CI-XA 解释为可能由分析 CI-XA 时对非晶部分贡献过拟合所致，这是一种推测（“might be caused”）[1]。"

      "text": "**③ 因此不能用 CI-XI “直接算出”氢键含量。**\n- 作者自己的表述只是趋势推测：“there was a significantly positive correlation between the CI-XI and content of O(6)H···O(3)′ H-bonds… Thus, the trend of the content of O(6)H···O(3)′ H-bonds **might be generally speculated** based on CI-XI while refining”[4]，并没有宣称可以定量换算。\n- 在所检索到的章节中，未见任何回归方程或换算公式；这是“检索范围内未见”，不能断言全文一定没有，需要回原文全文核实。\n- 这些相关性是在 **PFI 打浆处理中**（0、4000、8000、12000、16000 r 共 5 个水平，每个树种 5 个点）内部得到的[5][6]；据表 1、表 2 推断，每树种只有 5 个配对点，样本量很小，r≈0.9 足以说明趋势一致，但不足以支撑外推到其他原料或打浆条件（此为统计判断，不是原文结论）。\n- 该“氢键含量”是 FT-IR 羟基谱带（3000–3700 cm⁻¹）去卷积后按峰面积占比得到的**相对含量**[6]，因此不是绝对含量；相关也不等于因果。\n- 并且并不是所有氢键都能由 CI-XI 代表：O(2)H···O(6) 与自由 OH(2)/OH(6) 在晶区与非晶区差别较小，与 CI-XI 的相关性“poor”；O(3)H···O(5) 被认为稳定、变化很小，本文未讨论其与 CI-XI 的相关性[2]。作者把 O(6)H···O(3′) 与 CI-XI 趋势相似归因于结晶区该类氢键含量高于非晶区[2]，这属于机理推测（“might be because”）。"
    },
    {
      "basis": null,
      "basis_locator": "NONE",
      "claim_type": "fact",
      "id": "C4",
      "support": "supported",
      "text": "**④ 建议表述**：“CI-XI 与 CI-XA 高度相关（软木 0.919、阔叶木 0.925，p<0.05）[1]；CI-XI 与 O(6)H···O(3′) 分子间氢键相对含量显著正相关（正文：软木 0.912、阔叶木 0.889；摘要：0.888/0.889）[2][3]。作者据此仅提出可用 CI-XI 大致推测该氢键含量的变化趋势[4]，并未建立定量换算关系，不宜作为由 CI-XI 计算氢键含量的依据。”"
    },
    {
